title: Duecare Chat Playground Wheels
subtitle: v3.16 baseline harness-OFF Gemma 4 chat (the failure mode)
description: v3.6 / chat-package 0.2.0 (2026-05-06) — 21-dim rubric (added operational_information_provided + harm_enablement_check), use-case-aware analog prompt classifier (multi-lingual: en/tl/id/ne/bn/my/ar/es/vi/si/ta/ur), curator-block JSON governance, judge → evaluator rename. v3.16 - wheels for the baseline chat-playground (harness OFF).
